## Output
The agreed contributor exposes package/source facts using its exported contract, reusing ProjectTools discovery.

## Work
Preserve declared production-dependency coverage and discovered source packages outside the configured build. Keep observed import evidence distinct. Remove duplicate knowledge within this slice; do not introduce a second synchronized representation.

## Why here
The boundary review determines the owner and contract before discovery code is moved or reworked.

## Evidence
Focused discovery tests, typed consumer examples and compile-time rejection cases from the reviewed strategy. Record any invariant that cannot be compiler-enforced and its runtime owner.
properties.title: Contribute source facts through owned types
